# Casdoor

> Casdoor is an open-source, UI-first Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Single Sign-On (SSO) platform written in Go. It supports OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, CAS, LDAP, SCIM, WebAuthn, TOTP, MFA, RADIUS and Kerberos, includes an MCP server, and acts as an OAuth 2.1 authorization server for MCP servers and AI agents.

## The basics

- [Visión general](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/overview/): Casdoor is an open-source, UI-first IAM and SSO platform written in Go, supporting OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, CAS, LDAP, SCIM, WebAuthn, MFA and RADIUS. See how it works.
- [Core concepts](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/basic/core-concepts/): Organizations, users, applications, and providers—the main building blocks of Casdoor.
- [Server installation](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/basic/server-installation/): Install and configure the Casdoor server from source or pre-built binaries.
- [Configuración](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/basic/configuration/): Configure the Casdoor backend and frontend via app.conf and Conf.js.
- [Try with Docker](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/basic/try-with-docker/): Run Casdoor using Docker or Docker Compose for quick testing or production.
- [Try with Helm](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/basic/try-with-helm/): Deploy Casdoor on Kubernetes using Helm for manageable, scalable deployments.
- [Public API](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/basic/public-api/): Authenticate and call the Casdoor REST API from your apps and scripts.
- [Tutoriales](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/basic/tutorials/): Third-party product docs and articles that use Casdoor for SSO or auth.

## Comparisons

- [Casdoor vs. alternatives](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/comparison/overview/): How Casdoor compares with Keycloak, Authentik, Auth0, and Logto on language, license, protocols, AI agent and MCP support, and operations.
- [Casdoor vs. Keycloak](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-keycloak/): A practical comparison of Casdoor and Keycloak - architecture, protocols, customization, AI agent and MCP support, operations, and how to migrate users from Keycloak.
- [Casdoor vs. Authentik](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-authentik/): Casdoor and Authentik compared for self-hosted SSO - architecture, flows and UI customization, protocols, reverse-proxy authentication, licensing, and AI agent support.
- [Casdoor vs. Auth0](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-auth0/): Casdoor compared with Auth0 - open source and self-hosting versus a managed service, pricing model, data residency, customization, and AI agent and MCP support.
- [Casdoor vs. Logto](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-logto/): Casdoor and Logto compared - language and license, databases, protocols, multi-tenancy, enterprise directory features, and authentication for AI agents and MCP servers.

## LLM

- [OpenClaw](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/llm/openclaw/): Collect LLM agent traces, metrics, and logs in Casdoor using the OpenClaw observability agent.
- [MCP security](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/llm/mcp-security/): How Casdoor secures MCP deployments — OAuth 2.1 for access control and OpenTelemetry for audit and observability.

## Despliegue

- [Deploying with Docker](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/deployment/docker/): Run Casdoor with Docker or Docker Compose and optional reverse proxies.
- [Deploying behind Nginx](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/deployment/nginx/): Put Nginx in front of the Casdoor backend to serve and proxy traffic.
- [Desplegando en Kubernetes](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/deployment/k8s/): Deploy Casdoor in a Kubernetes cluster using the example manifests.
- [Data initialization](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/deployment/data-initialization/): Initialize or migrate Casdoor data using JSON config files.
- [Terraform](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/deployment/terraform/): Manage Casdoor organizations, applications, users, providers, certs, roles, permissions and groups as code with the official Terraform provider.
- [Hosting static files in a CDN](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/deployment/deploy-cdn/): Deploy Casdoor frontend static assets to a CDN using a storage provider.
- [Hosting static files on an intranet](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/deployment/deploy-intranet/): Serve Casdoor static assets from an intranet-accessible URL.
- [Database migration](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/deployment/db-migration/): How Casdoor handles database schema and data migrations.
- [Version information](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/deployment/version-info/): How Casdoor reports its version for binaries, Docker, and git builds.

## Connecting to Casdoor

- [Visión general](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/overview/): Connect your application to Casdoor using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, or CAS.
- [Cliente OIDC estándar](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/oidc-client/): Connect to Casdoor with any OIDC client using discovery endpoints.
- [SDKs de Casdoor](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/sdk/): Use Casdoor SDKs for frontend and backend integration with user management and more.
- [Single sign-on (SSO)](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/session/single-sign-on/): Let users sign in once and access all apps in the organization without signing in again.
- [Single sign-out (SSO logout)](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/session/single-sign-out/): Log users out from all applications in the organization at once.
- [RP-initiated logout](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/session/rp-initiated-logout/): Log a user out of Casdoor from a relying party using the OIDC RP-Initiated Logout endpoint.
- [Vue SDK](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/vue-sdk/): Use Casdoor in Vue 2 or Vue 3 with the official Vue SDK.
- [Electron app](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/electron-app/): Integrate Casdoor in an Electron app with OAuth and a custom protocol.
- [.NET desktop app](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/dotnet-app/): Integrate Casdoor in a .NET desktop app with WebView2.
- [.NET MAUI app](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/maui-app/): Integrate Casdoor in a .NET MAUI app (Android, Windows, etc.) with OpenID Connect.
- [Qt desktop app](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/qt-app/): Integrate Casdoor in a Qt (C++) desktop app with WebEngine.
- [React Native app](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/mobile-sdks/react-native-app/): Integrate Casdoor in a React Native app with the official SDK.
- [Casdoor CLI](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/cli/): Using Casdoor's official command-line interface for managing users, groups, and permissions
- [Plugins and middlewares](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/plugin/): Official Casdoor plugins for Spring Boot, WordPress, Odoo, Django, Kibana, Chrome, and Terraform.
- [Chrome extension](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/chrome-extension/): Integrate Casdoor OAuth in a Chrome extension.
- [Next.js](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/nextjs/): Integrate Casdoor in a Next.js app with middleware and the JS SDK.
- [Nuxt](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/nuxt/): Integrate Casdoor in a Nuxt app with middleware and the JS SDK.
- [OAuth 2.0](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/oauth/): Obtain, verify, and use access tokens with Casdoor’s OAuth 2.0 endpoints.
- [Guest authentication](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/guest-auth/): Create temporary users without credentials and upgrade them later.
- [Kerberos/SPNEGO authentication](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/kerberos/): Configure Kerberos/SPNEGO (Integrated Windows Authentication) for single sign-on.
- [Casdoor as a CAS server](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/cas/): Use Casdoor as a Central Authentication Service (CAS) server for CAS 1.0, 2.0, and 3.0.
- [SAML IdP overview](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/saml/overview/): Use Casdoor as a SAML 2.0 identity provider.
- [AWS Client VPN (SAML)](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/saml/aws/): Use Casdoor as SAML IdP for AWS Client VPN.
- [Keycloak (SAML)](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/saml/keycloak/): Use Casdoor as SAML IdP in Keycloak.
- [Google Workspace (SAML)](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/saml/google-workspace/): Use Casdoor as SAML IdP for Google Workspace SSO.
- [Appgate (SAML POST)](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/saml/appgate/): Use Casdoor as SAML IdP for Appgate SDP (POST SAMLResponse).
- [Tencent Cloud (SAML)](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/saml/tencent-cloud/): Use Casdoor as SAML IdP for Tencent Cloud CAM.
- [MCP server overview](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/overview/): Use Casdoor’s MCP server for programmatic access via JSON-RPC 2.0.
- [MCP authentication](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/authentication/): OAuth discovery and authentication methods for the MCP server.
- [MCP tools reference](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/tools/): List and call MCP tools (applications and more).
- [MCP authorization and scopes](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/authorization/): Scope-based access control for MCP tools.
- [MCP integration example](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/integration/): Python example: scoped token and MCP tool calls.
- [MCP error handling](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/error-handling/): JSON-RPC error codes and responses from the MCP server.
- [MCP troubleshooting](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/troubleshooting/): Common MCP and OAuth issues and how to debug them.
- [Connect Claude Desktop to MCP](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-claude-desktop/): Connect Claude Desktop to Casdoor’s MCP server with OAuth.
- [Connect Cursor to MCP](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-cursor/): Connect Cursor IDE to Casdoor’s MCP server with OAuth.
- [Connect ChatGPT to MCP](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-chatgpt/): Connect ChatGPT to Casdoor’s MCP server with OAuth.
- [Face ID](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/face-id/): Sign in with Face ID using face-api.js.
- [WebAuthn](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/how-to-connect/webauthn/): Sign in with WebAuthn (passkeys, fingerprint, face, security keys).

## Organizaciones

- [Visión general](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/organization/overview/): Organizations are the core unit in Casdoor for managing users and applications.
- [Organization tree](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/organization/organization-tree/): User groups and group hierarchy within an organization.
- [Password complexity](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/organization/passwordComplexity/): Configure password strength rules per organization.
- [Ofuscador de contraseña](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/organization/passwordObfuscator/): Encrypt password parameters in login and set-password APIs.
- [Account customization](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/organization/accountCustomization/): Control visibility and edit permissions for each user account field.
- [Personalizar tema](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/organization/customize-theme/): Set primary color and border radius at global, organization, or application level.
- [Elementos MFA - Información adicional](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/organization/mfa-items/): Configure which MFA methods are available and whether they are optional or required.

## Aplicaciones

- [Visión general](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/overview/): Learn how applications work in Casdoor and how to configure authentication for your services.
- [Application terminology](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/terminology/): Reference for application configuration fields and options, organized by tab.
- [Application configuration](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/config/): Configure authentication and callback URLs for your Casdoor applications.
- [Dynamic client registration](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/dynamic-client-registration/): Register OAuth clients programmatically via RFC 7591 (DCR).
- [Application categories](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/categories/): Default (user-facing) vs Agent (M2M) applications and their types.
- [Permisos personalizados](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/scopes/): Define custom OAuth scopes for Agent applications (e.g. MCP servers).
- [Proveedores](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/providers/): Attach providers to your application and set rules (signup, login, forgot password, MFA, etc.).
- [Sign-in methods](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/signin-methods/): Configure which sign-in methods are available and their order on the login page.
- [Exclusive sign-in](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/exclusive-signin/): Allow only one active session per user per application.
- [Sign-up items table](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/signup-items-table/): Configure signup items to build a custom registration page.
- [Sign-in items table](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/signin-items-table/): Configure signin items to build a custom sign-in page.
- [Login UI customization](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/ui-customization/): Customize the sign-in page: background, panel style, position, and side panel.
- [Specify login organization](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/specify-login-organization/): Let users choose or enter the organization on the sign-in page.
- [Application tags](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/tags/): Restrict sign-in to users whose tags match the application’s tags.
- [Invitation codes](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/invitation-code/): Restrict sign-up to invited users with Casdoor invitation codes - create codes per application and require a valid code on the sign-up page.
- [Shared application](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/application/shared-application/): Use one application across multiple organizations with org-specific client IDs.

- [Casdoor as MCP Auth Provider](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/mcp-auth/overview/): Use Casdoor as an external OAuth 2.1 authorization server for third-party MCP servers
- [MCP auth setup](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/mcp-auth/setup/): Configure Casdoor as the OAuth server for your MCP server.
- [Third-party MCP server integration](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/mcp-auth/third-party-integration/): Runnable code examples for MCP servers using Casdoor OAuth (Python, Node.js, Go).
- [Public MCP Server Registry](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/mcp-auth/mcp-registry/): A curated registry of publicly available MCP servers, with a web UI and machine-readable JSON API.

## Permisos

- [Visión general](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/permission/overview/): Use Casbin to manage fine-grained access control for users and resources in your organization.
- [Permission configuration](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/permission/permission-configuration/): Configure Casbin permission policies and each field on the Edit Permission page.
- [APIs expuestas de Casbin](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/permission/exposed-casbin-apis/): Call Casbin from your backend to enforce and manage permissions.
- [Adaptador](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/permission/adapter/): Connect Casbin policy storage (database) and manage policies in the UI.

- [Cloudflare Turnstile](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/captcha/cloudflareTurnstile/): Add Cloudflare Turnstile captcha to your application.
- [reCAPTCHA](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/captcha/recaptcha/): Add Google reCAPTCHA v2 Checkbox to your application.
- [hCaptcha](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/captcha/hcaptcha/): Add hCaptcha to your application as a captcha provider.
- [Alibaba Cloud Captcha](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/captcha/aliyunCaptcha/): Agregar Alibaba Cloud Captcha a tu aplicación
- [Geetest captcha](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/captcha/geetest/): Add Geetest CAPTCHA V4 to your application.
- [MetaMask Web3](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/web3/metamask/): Use MetaMask as a Web3 sign-in provider.
- [Web3-Onboard](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/web3/web3onboard/): Use Web3-Onboard to support multiple wallets for Web3 sign-in.
- [Face ID overview](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/faceid/overview/): Use Face ID as a sign-in method.
- [Alibaba Cloud FaceBody](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/faceid/alibaba_cloud_facebody/): Use Alibaba Cloud FaceBody for face verification.
- [ID verification provider overview](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/idv/overview/): Verify user identity via third-party ID verification (KYC) providers.
- [Jumio ID verification](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/idv/jumio/): Use Jumio as an ID verification (KYC) provider in Casdoor.
- [Alibaba Cloud](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/idv/alibaba-cloud/): Verify users' national ID cards against government records with Alibaba Cloud ID verification as a Casdoor identity verification provider.
- [Log providers](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/log/overview/): Collect OS logs, SELinux audit events, OpenTelemetry data, and permission audit events into Casdoor Entry records.
- [Scan provider overview](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/scan/overview/): Scan networks and web targets to discover servers or security issues, e.g. for MCP or vulnerability scanning.
- [MCP Scan](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/scan/mcp/): Scan intranet address ranges to discover MCP servers.
- [Security Scan](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/scan/security/): Fingerprint web targets and report matching known vulnerabilities (CVEs).

## Recursos

- [Visión general](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/resources/overview/): Upload and manage files and images as resources using a storage provider.

## Claves

- [Claves](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/key/overview/): Manage API access keys (AccessKey/AccessSecret pairs) scoped to an organization, application, or user.

## SaaS management

- [Visión general](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/pricing/overview/): Use Casdoor for subscription and pricing: plans, payments, and subscriptions.
- [Producto](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/products/product/): Define products (or services) to sell and attach payment providers.
- [Product store](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/products/product-store/): Publish products to a storefront where users can browse and purchase
- [Shopping cart](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/products/cart/): The Casdoor shopping cart collects several products so users can buy them together in one order and one payment.
- [Pago](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/products/payment/): View payment records, states, and issue invoices.
- [Orden](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/products/order/): Casdoor orders record each product purchase and track it through its lifecycle, separately from the payments made for it.
- [Plan](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/pricing/plan/): Define a plan’s features and price; plans are tied to roles and products.
- [Precio](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/pricing/): Group one or more plans so users can sign up at different price points.
- [Suscripción](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/pricing/subscription/): Manage a user’s selected plan and application access.
- [Transaction](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/pricing/transaction/): Track payments and balance changes for users and organizations.
- [Coupon](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/pricing/coupon/): Create discount coupons and apply them to orders at checkout.

- [Push notification](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/provider/mfa/push/): Send MFA verification codes through push notification services such as Duo and Pushover, using Casdoor notification providers.

- [User roles](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/user/roles/): Assign and manage roles for users; use roles with permission policies.

## Sincronizador

- [Visión general](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/syncer/overview/): Sync users from external systems (databases, Azure AD, Keycloak, etc.) into Casdoor.
- [Database syncer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/syncer/Database/): Sync user data from an external database into Casdoor.
- [Azure AD syncer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/syncer/AzureAD/): Sync users from Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID) to Casdoor via Microsoft Graph.
- [Active Directory syncer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/syncer/ActiveDirectory/): Sync users from Microsoft Active Directory to Casdoor via LDAP/LDAPS.
- [Google Workspace syncer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/syncer/GoogleWorkspace/): Sync users from Google Workspace to Casdoor via the Admin SDK Directory API.
- [Keycloak syncer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/syncer/Keycloak/): Sync users from Keycloak to Casdoor with automatic schema mapping.
- [Okta syncer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/syncer/Okta/): Sync users from Okta to Casdoor via the Okta Users API.
- [SCIM 2.0 syncer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/syncer/SCIM/): Pull users into Casdoor from any SCIM 2.0-compliant identity provider.
- [AWS IAM syncer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/syncer/AWSIAM/): Sync users and groups from AWS IAM into Casdoor.
- [WeCom syncer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/syncer/WeCom/): Sync users from WeCom (企业微信) to Casdoor via the WeCom API.
- [DingTalk syncer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/syncer/DingTalk/): Sync users from DingTalk (钉钉) to Casdoor via the DingTalk API.
- [Lark syncer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/syncer/Lark/): Sync users from Lark (Feishu) to Casdoor via the Lark Open Platform API.

## Integraciones

- [Nginx](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/C++/Nginx/): Enable OpenID Connect single sign-on for applications proxied by NGINX Plus, using Casdoor as the identity provider.
- [Nginx community edition](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/C++/NginxCommunityVersion/): Add Casdoor single sign-on to applications behind open-source Nginx (not NGINX Plus) with OAuth2 Proxy and auth_request.
- [Envoy](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/C++/Envoy/): Protect services behind the Envoy proxy with Casdoor single sign-on, using Envoy's OAuth2 filter and a Casdoor application.
- [Unity](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/CSharp/Unity/): Utilice Casdoor-dotnet-sdk para el desarrollo en Unity.
- [Kubernetes](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/go/kubernetes/): Authenticate users to the Kubernetes API server with OpenID Connect, using Casdoor as the OIDC identity provider for kubectl.
- [OpenShift](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/go/openshift/): Configure Casdoor as an OpenID Connect identity provider for OpenShift so users sign in to the console and CLI with their Casdoor accounts.
- [BookStack](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/go/bookstack/): Set up Casdoor as the OAuth sign-in provider for BookStack, the open-source wiki and documentation platform.
- [Bytebase](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/go/Bytebase/): Use Casdoor as the OAuth2/OIDC provider for Bytebase SSO.
- [ELK](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/go/elk/): Put Casdoor single sign-on in front of Kibana with elk-auth-casdoor or casdoor-forward-auth, without X-Pack's paid SSO features.
- [Gitea](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/go/gitea/): Use Casdoor as the OAuth/OIDC provider for Gitea sign-in.
- [Grafana](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/go/grafana/): Use Casdoor as the OAuth provider for Grafana sign-in.
- [MinIO](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/go/minio/): Configurando Casdoor como un proveedor de identidad para soportar MinIO
- [Traefik](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/go/traefik/): Protect services behind Traefik with Casdoor SSO using casdoor-forward-auth and Traefik's forwardAuth middleware.
- [Portainer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/go/portainer/): Configure Portainer OAuth sign-in with Casdoor as the identity provider, so users log in to Portainer with their Casdoor accounts.
- [Spring Boot](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/spring-boot/): Add Casdoor sign-in to a Spring Boot application with casdoor-spring-boot-starter - configuration, login redirect, callback and user info.
- [Spring Cloud](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/spring-cloud/): Add Casdoor authentication to Spring Cloud microservices, at the gateway or in individual services with casdoor-spring-boot-starter.
- [Spring Cloud Gateway](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/spring-cloud-gateway/): Authenticate requests at a Spring Cloud Gateway with Casdoor, using casdoor-spring-boot-starter in the gateway service.
- [Spring Security OAuth](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/spring-security/spring-security-oauth/): Use Casdoor as the OpenID Connect provider for a Spring Security application with spring-boot-starter-oauth2-client.
- [Spring Security filter (OIDC)](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/spring-security/spring-security-filter/): Integrate Casdoor with Spring Security using OIDC.
- [Plugin de Jenkins](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/jenkins-plugin/): Install and configure the Casdoor plugin for Jenkins so users sign in to Jenkins with Casdoor single sign-on.
- [Jenkins (OIDC)](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/jenkins-oidc/): Use Casdoor as the OIDC IdP for Jenkins sign-in.
- [Via built-in SSO](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/jira2/): Connect Jira to Casdoor over OpenID Connect with Jira's built-in SSO, a free method that requires HTTPS.
- [Using the miniOrange plugin](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/jira/): Connect Jira to Casdoor over OpenID Connect with the miniOrange OAuth / OIDC SSO plugin.
- [Connecting applications with OIDC protocol - Confluence](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/Confluence/): Connect Atlassian Confluence to Casdoor with OpenID Connect so users sign in to Confluence through Casdoor single sign-on.
- [RuoYi](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/RuoYi/): Integrate Casdoor single sign-on into RuoYi-Cloud, the Spring Cloud admin framework, using the Casdoor Java SDK.
- [Pulsar manager](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/Pulsar-manager/): Enable Casdoor sign-in for Apache Pulsar Manager - configure application.yml on the back end and turn on the Casdoor switch in the front end.
- [Usando Casdoor en ShenYu](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/shenyu/): Protect APIs behind the Apache ShenYu gateway with Casdoor using ShenYu's Casdoor plugin.
- [ShardingSphere](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/ShardingSphere/): Enable Casdoor sign-in for the Apache ShardingSphere ElasticJob UI, which includes built-in Casdoor support.
- [Apache IoTDB](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/iotdb/): Enable Casdoor sign-in for the Apache IoTDB Web Workbench, which includes built-in Casdoor support.
- [Apache DolphinScheduler](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/dolphinscheduler/): Enable Casdoor single sign-on for Apache DolphinScheduler, which supports Casdoor as a built-in login method.
- [FireZone](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/firezone/): Configure Firezone to use Casdoor as its OpenID Connect identity provider for user sign-in.
- [Cloud Foundry](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/CloudFoundry/): Use Casdoor as the OIDC identity provider for applications on Cloud Foundry, with step-by-step Casdoor and Cloud Foundry configuration.
- [Thingsboard](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/java/Thingsboard/): Use Casdoor as the OAuth 2.0 / OIDC identity provider for the ThingsBoard IoT platform, with Casdoor and ThingsBoard settings.
- [Firebase](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/javascript/firebase/): Use Casdoor as an OpenID Connect provider in Firebase Authentication, so users of a Firebase web app sign in with Casdoor.
- [WeChat mini program](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/javascript/wechat_miniprogram/): Integrate Casdoor sign-in in a WeChat Mini Program (no OAuth redirect).
- [APISIX](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/lua/apisix/): Protect APIs behind Apache APISIX with Casdoor, using either the authz-casdoor plugin or the openid-connect plugin.
- [Zabbix](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/php/Zabbix/): Use Casdoor as the SAML IdP for Zabbix SSO.
- [WordPress (CAS SSO)](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/php/WordPress/): Use Casdoor as CAS IdP for WordPress with the wp-cassify plugin.
- [Zentao](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/php/zentao/): Add Casdoor single sign-on to the ZenTao project management tool with the zentao-oidc module.
- [Usando Casdoor como un servidor OAuth2 en ShowDoc](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/php/showdoc/): Use Casdoor as the OAuth 2.0 server for ShowDoc sign-in, the API and technical documentation platform.
- [Flarum](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/php/Flarum/): Add Casdoor OAuth 2.0 sign-in to a Flarum forum with the FoF Passport extension.
- [Moodle](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/php/Moodle/): Configure Moodle to use Casdoor as an OAuth identity provider for single sign-on.
- [GitLab](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/ruby/gitlab/): Configure self-managed GitLab to use Casdoor as its OpenID Connect provider for single sign-on.
- [Hasura](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/Haskell/Hasura/): Secure Hasura GraphQL Engine with JWTs issued by Casdoor - configure the Casdoor application, Hasura JWT secret and claims mapping.
- [FastAPI](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/python/FastAPI/): Add Casdoor sign-in and Casdoor permission checks to a FastAPI app with the community casbin-fastapi-decorator library.
- [JumpServer](https://casdoor.ai/es/docs/integration/python/JumpServer/): Connect the JumpServer bastion host to Casdoor over CAS so users sign in with Casdoor single sign-on.
